BiblicalUsage: Hodevah, also spelled Hodevjah, is an Israelite named once in Nehemiah 7:43, among the Levites who returned with Zerubbabel. He stands in the list of the singers' sons, a name carried home from exile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hodevah matters because God knows His people by name — even the ones Scripture mentions only once.
